Small businesses have a quiet digital anxiety: “everything seems to work, but it feels like it isn’t really mine.”

Usually, this is not about the visuals.

It is about control: who owns the domain, the content, the history, the access credentials, and the very first contact with the Client?

In this article, I break down a simple framework: a platform may generate leads, but it should not be the only foundation of the business.

The proper test here is very practical 🙂 If tomorrow you decide to leave, will you be able to quickly take back what is yours?

If not, then the digital asset most likely only looks like it is yours. And that is no longer a matter of marketing, but of business architecture.
